scenes.say: You see perfectly. So why get an eye test this year? Myth or fact?

scenes.en: "If I see clearly, my eyes are healthy."
scenes.ta: தெளிவாக தெரிந்தால் கண் ஆரோக்கியம் என்பது தவறு
scenes.say: Myth. If I see clearly, my eyes must be healthy.

scenes.en: Clear sight is only part of the story. Pressure, nerve and retina need a proper check.
scenes.ta: கண் அழுத்தம், நரம்பு, விழித்திரையை சோதிக்க வேண்டும்
scenes.say: Fact. Sharp vision tells only part of the story. Your eye pressure, the optic nerve and the retina at the back of the eye can only be checked in a proper eye exam.

scenes.en: Studies show about half of people with glaucoma do not know they have it.
scenes.ta: கிளாக்கோமா உள்ள பாதி பேருக்கு அது தெரியாது
scenes.say: Did you know? Studies show about half of people with glaucoma do not know they have it. Early on, there is no pain and no blur.

scenes.en: Power changes slowly. Kids grow. After 40, focus changes. Diabetes and BP affect eyes.
scenes.ta: பவர் மெதுவாக மாறும். 40க்கு பிறகு கவனம் தேவை
scenes.say: Why every year? Power can change slowly without you noticing. Children grow fast. After forty, near focus changes. And diabetes or high blood pressure can affect the eyes.

scenes.en: Sudden blur, eye pain or a dark shadow: see an eye specialist the same day.
scenes.ta: திடீர் மங்கல், வலி, நிழல்: அன்றே கண் மருத்துவரை பாருங்கள்
scenes.say: And if you get sudden blur, eye pain, or a dark shadow in your vision, see an eye specialist the same day.

scenes.en: Book an eye test for the whole family.
scenes.say: New year, new start. Book an eye test for the whole family.
